A small bar in a residential alley. Should I call it dachi? It is structured as if you are sitting around a large table in the center. Although it is a small space, it was well decorated to create a cozy and comfortable atmosphere.

While making kimchi, I added the kimchi kimchi and oyster stew menu, but I was told that the quantity was limited, so I ordered the last plate. The savory and chewy boiled pork served with crunchy kimchi, salted cutlassfish, oysters, and scallions was so delicious and a good combination.
Because I didn't have time, I was only able to try the kimchi and boiled pork menu, but I will visit again soon to try other menu items and new drinks. It's delicious, comfortable, and both the owner and the customers are cheerful, so it's a pleasant place.
